news.label: ZONOS3-Mini: Local Text-to-Speech
details: Zyphra's text-to-speech model also supports zero-shot voice cloning from a short audio clip and speaking style adjustment.
Runtimes including WebGPU, MLX for Apple Silicon, and ggml are also available.
The latency figure comes from the developer's own measurement on an M3 MacBook Air. The model has about 800 million parameters in total, with roughly 100 million active at inference.

news.label: Power Tunnel Inspection Experiment
points: Quadruped robot and drone team up
details: The robot covers the floor and lower levels, while the drone handles the upper levels and the ceiling.
In a simulation with assumed conditions, human visual inspection found 1 of 8 anomalies, while the combined approach found all 8.
Inspection time rose from 8 minutes 49 seconds to 20 minutes 44 seconds. These are not figures from real facilities.

lines.say: Now, a power tunnel inspection simulation from Space Data.
lines.show: Now, a power tunnel inspection simulation from Space Data.

lines.say: A four-legged robot and a drone split the work, one watching the floor and the other the ceiling.
lines.show: A four-legged robot and a drone split the work, one on the floor and one on the ceiling.

lines.say: The results show fewer missed problems than visual inspection, but it takes more time.
lines.show: The results show fewer missed problems than visual inspection, but it takes more time.

news.label: XYBench: A New AI Evaluation
points: Can AI spot the goal behind a question?
details: It evaluates whether a model can tell the method someone asked for apart from the goal they truly want to achieve.
The questions were collected from programming and everyday problem solving. The dataset and evaluation code are also public.
The leading models tested often mentioned the real goal, yet mostly answered with solutions that followed the flawed premise.
